events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The ongoing conflict in Iran has led to increased tensions in the Middle East, with potential implications for global oil prices and geopolitical stability. The US and its allies are considering further military action, while Iran has vowed to retaliate against any aggression. The situation remains highly volatile, with potential for rapid escalation.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The conflict in Iran has the potential to disrupt global oil supplies, leading to higher prices and increased volatility in the energy sector. A further escalation of the conflict could lead to a broader geopolitical crisis, with potential implications for global markets and economies.

timeFrame.note: Monitor developments in the conflict and adjust positions accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Close positions if the conflict de-escalates or if oil prices stabilize

gains.baseNote: If the conflict escalates and oil prices rise
gains.extendedNote: If the conflict leads to a broader geopolitical crisis
